description: He wears a textured burgundy-maroon knee-length open-front outer coat with short loose sleeves and broad tan-gold geometric woven borders down the front, around the sleeves and along the hem. Beneath it is a cream linen-like long-sleeved undertunic with dark patterned edging at the split neckline, cuffs and lower hem. A dark brown leather belt with a brass-colored rounded buckle circles the waist; its long hanging end has a small ornamental metal tip. Brown fitted trousers continue into worn dark brown leather calf-high boots with wraparound ankle straps and low heels. No headgear or weapon is visible.
